title: Transduction of paired bits
statement: Let $\sigma$ be a set, let $\delta : \sigma \times \{0,1\} \times \{0,1\} \to \sigma$ and $o : \sigma \times \{0,1\} \times \{0,1\} \to \{0,1\}$, let $s \in \sigma$, and let $ps$ be a finite list of bit pairs. A one-pass transducer started in state $(\bot,s)$, which stores the first bit of each pair and updates its state by $\delta$ on the second bit while emitting $o$ of the current state and the pair, outputs exactly the serial output obtained by processing the pairs in $ps$ from state $s$. Its input is the word formed by listing each pair's two bits consecutively.
hypotheses_covered: A state transition function on a state and two bits
A Boolean output function on a state and two bits
A finite list of bit pairs
